title: EMBODIED // OS tutor session summary (HANDOVERFINAL §23)
description: The tutor outputs exactly this object at session end. The app ingests it as evidence — it is never mastery by itself.

node_id.description: The skill-node id from the session packet, e.g. l2-matrices

verified_strengths.description: Things the learner produced correctly, unaided, in-session

full_solution_exposures.description: Anything the tutor fully solved/showed — counts against independence

recommended_mastery_candidate.description: Node id the tutor believes is ready for its prove-it, or null
